semantic_contract.task_statement: Convert a non-negative decimal integer into its binary string representation.

result.canonical_semantics: Binary representation of the supplied decimal integer; leading zeroes are semantically insignificant.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite provides broad core behavioural evidence using five frozen semantic fixtures covering zero, one, a representative value, a power of two and a larger value. Negative input is evaluated separately through semantic-boundary variance.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 5 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Negative integers are outside the NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER contract and are reported separately through the semantic-boundary probe stream.
manual_review_targets: Confirm assignment corrections remain '=' semantics and bit sequence preserves 23.
